name: Koikishi Purely ☆ Kiss
source:
Meet Fujimori Kaname, a boy whose life was once saved by a knight amidst red flames and debris. That day changed him - his illusion of being all-powerful crumbled, but it wasn't despair that stayed with him. Instead, the image of the knight who rescued him inspired a vow: to become a knight who protects more people than anyone else.

Today, Kaname steps into Shiromiya Academy, a knight breeding ground. His first challenge? Joining the Shiromiya Squire Knights "Esquire", a test order for new student knights.

Kaname's journey is not just about training. It's about the companions he'll share it with: Elcia Harvence, with her striking golden hair and skillful swordplay; Kazama Akari, the spirited and impulsive girl from a modest background; Shidou Mana, the homely, marriage-ready daughter of a corporate giant; and his prodigious sister, Fujimori Yuu, who's a grade-skipping genius. Leading them all is Kuninaka Kaori, the calm and caring senior.

But there's a twist - Kaname realizes he's the only guy in the group. Amidst the confusion and a bit of worry, Kaname embarks on his knightly journey, stepping into a world of uncertainties and adventures.

[Based on the [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/koikishi/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
藤守要曾在烈焰与瓦砾中被一名骑士救下。那一天改变了他：他不再天真地以为自己无所不能，但留在心中的并非绝望。救命恩人的身影反而让他立下誓言，要成为比任何人都能守护更多人的骑士。

如今，要踏入培养骑士的白宫学园。他面临的第一项挑战，是加入白宫从骑士团“Esquire”——一个供骑士新生接受考验的见习组织。

要的旅程并不只有训练，还有与他并肩前行的伙伴：金发耀眼、剑术精湛的艾尔希娅·哈文斯；出身普通、活泼冲动的风间明莉；贤惠能干、宜室宜家，又是企业巨头千金的狮堂真奈；以及跳级入学的天才妹妹藤守由宇。沉着体贴的学姐国中佳织负责带领众人。

然而，要很快发现，自己竟是小队中唯一的男性。带着困惑与些许不安，他就此踏上充满未知与冒险的骑士之路。

[根据 [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/koikishi/story.html]官方网站[/url]整理]
